name: Universal Test Runner
author: Tahr Team
description: Multi-language test discoverer and runner supporting Go (go test), Rust (cargo test), Python (pytest), TS/JS (vitest/jest), and C/C++ (ctest)

auto_run_on_save.description: Automatically run affected unit tests when saving a file

codelens_buttons.description: Display interactive Run / Debug buttons above test functions

show_output_drawer.description: Pop up the test runner drawer automatically during execution
